rounding_regression.before: Old per-row lazy order selected [0,1] before [0,0] when both computed totals were equal. The new regression failed before the fix.
rounding_regression.after: Per-mode-parent choices use the actual fsum total and token order. The same regression passed.
rounding_regression.scope: Computed-score ordering, not an assertion of exact real-arithmetic ranking.
rounding_regression.selection_bound: Only the first B children per mode-parent are retained. Any omitted child has B distinct same-parent siblings ahead.
